mutations.name: the tap sends an agent's frames to every open feed rather than to the feeds watching that agent
mutations.find: for (const res of watchers.targets(verdict.agent)) if (!res.writableEnded) send(res, "agent-frame", verdict.data);
mutations.replace: for (const res of feeds.values()) if (!res.writableEnded) send(res, "agent-frame", verdict.data);
mutations.expectRed: 2.6 a second feed that does not watch receives nothing for the agent
mutations.cell: 2.6 a second feed that does not watch receives nothing for the agent

mutations.name: unwatch answers 204 and does nothing, so a closed session keeps receiving its agent's frames
mutations.expectRed: 6.2 after unwatch, the next frame reaches no feed
mutations.cell: 6.2 after unwatch, the next frame reaches no feed

mutations.name: the events route reads the agent's event channel from any sender, so a frame another principal published there shows in the agent's session history
mutations.find: const publisher = { owner: agent.owner, actor: agent.actor };
mutations.expectRed: 8.2 the events route reads only the frames the agent published: the forged one is absent and the agent's own are all there
mutations.cell: 8.2 the events route reads only the frames the agent published: the forged one is absent and the agent's own are all there

mutations.name: the events route answers any method as a read, so a POST or DELETE to it reads the agent's history
